function: system: over-the-air federated edge learning with AirComp aggregation (area 7) between a single-antenna access point and single-antenna ISAC devices, with no RIS (p. 3).
notes: Excluded for system. p. 3: "there is one edge server equipped with a single-antenna access point and K edge devices. All devices are each equipped with a single-antenna ISAC transceiver"; no RIS or multi-antenna setup appears anywhere. The earlier checks pass. Federated learning over the air passes no_learning. The AirComp aggregation (p. 5: channel-alignment power control and receive magnitude eta) is physical layer and is designed jointly with batch size, sensing power and CPU frequency (p. 7), so above_phy does not apply. The aggregation is over the air, so the work falls in area 7 and passes function; area 5 (ISAC resources) would also fall under the system rule. For the record, the proposed scheme is alternating convex optimization with closed-form KKT solutions (pp. 7-9), and the trained model is ResNet-10 on the sensing dataset of [30] with Rayleigh channel gains (p. 9). The PDF is arXiv 2508.15185v1, and its title and authors match the DOI record. Extraction note: scripts/pdf_text.py mis-paginates this PDF after page 9 because the figure text contains form-feed characters, which the script takes as page breaks; the text of pp. 10-14 is shifted and the appendices and references are dropped. I read pages 9-14 as rendered images, and the cited page (p. 3) is unaffected.
